'''Thiele''' is a German-language [[surname]].

==Geographical distribution==
As of 2014, 78.0% of all known bearers of the surname ''Thiele'' were residents of [[Germany]], 10.9% of the [[United States]], 2.3% of [[Australia]], 2.0% of [[Brazil]], 1.0% of [[Canada]] and 1.0% of [[South Africa]].

In Germany, the frequency of the surname was higher than national average (1:1,741) in the following states:<ref name="thiele2014">[http://forebears.co.uk/surnames/thiele#surnames Thiele surname distribution]</ref>
# [[Brandenburg]] (1:477)
# [[Saxony-Anhalt]] (1:522)
# [[Saxony]] (1:624)
# [[Bremen (state)|Bremen]] (1:1,058)
# [[Thuringia]] (1:1,132)
# [[Lower Saxony]] (1:1,241)
# [[Hamburg]] (1:1,465)
# [[Mecklenburg-Vorpommern]] (1:1,689)
# [[Berlin]] (1:1,708)
